project.title_zh: 京张万象工场｜文化生产驱动的AI公共产品转化带
project.approval_gate: Integrate only after deterministic, spatial, visual, PDF and independent manual review pass; publish only the formal submission allowlist.

judgements: 城市不是AI的展柜，而是共同作者。
让文化把AI变成城市公共产品。
京张不应再争“第四个AI园区”，而应建设技术成果进入真实城市的转化能力。
spatial_structure: 众智园：花园型创新超级街区
AI原点：近校细颗粒院落织体
大钟寺：轨道—城市—文保复合街区
main_narrative_systems: 文化生产驱动的AI公共产品转化过程

visual_gates.required_unverified_scale_label: 概念性空间原型 / NOT TO SCALE

formal_figure_roles.key-areas: 三处重点区为什么是三种不同街区
formal_figure_roles.mobility-bluegreen: 慢行、无障碍、后勤消防、水绿网络和文化锚点如何共存

downgraded_from_main_story: 五类责任智能体并列展示
五联账作为公众核心概念
没有具体空间对象的AI架构图
hard_fail: Chinese formal title is replaced or visually subordinated by English.
Any official polygon, redline, ownership, statutory control, investment, partner or implementation commitment is fabricated.
Any AI item fails to name the changed plan, section, ground-floor or operational object.
A test protocol is represented as a completed field test or algorithm performance result.
Any page claims 1:1000, 1:500 or 1:200 without complete geometry, print scale, dimension chain, coordinates and location basis.
Any effective text is smaller than the locked point size.
Any formal PDF is a full-page raster, has unembedded CJK fonts, missing glyphs or non-extractable Chinese text.
Any two consecutive A3 pages reuse the same main figure with only a new title.
Any public-facing G gate differs from canonical_gates or any competing G1-G5 lifecycle gate remains visible.

Any internal development, QA, build, script or requirements artifact that is absent from manifest.json and the formal submission allowlist is staged as a formal submission file; approved structured delivery records listed in the manifest are exempt.
